description: Defines a template class 'RingBuffer' for managing a ring buffer of serialized protocol buffer entries, including methods for serialization, file writing, appending, and dumping buffer info.

classes.name: RingBuffer
classes.description: A template class implementing a ring buffer for protocol buffer entries, supporting serialization, file output, appending, and diagnostics.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the maximum size in bytes of the ring buffer.

methods.name: used
methods.description: Returns the current used size in bytes.

methods.name: frameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries stored.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size in bytes.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns the front entry in the buffer.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns the back entry in the buffer.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears the buffer and releases memory.

methods.name: writeToProto
methods.description: Serializes buffer entries into a protocol buffer.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Serializes buffer and writes to a file.

methods.name: appendToStream
methods.description: Serializes buffer and appends to an output stream.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Adds a serialized proto to the buffer, evicting old entries if necessary.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Serializes a proto and adds it to the buffer.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs buffer info including entry count, size, and duration.
